questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.question: Which data structure is typically used to implement a breadth-first search (BFS) traversal?
questions.explanation: BFS visits vertices in layers, so a queue is used to process discovered vertices in first-in, first-out order.

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: Which of the following are necessary conditions for deadlock in the Coffman model?
questions.explanation: The four classic conditions are mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, and circular wait.

questions.subject: Discrete Mathematics
questions.question: A connected tree has 8 vertices. How many edges does it have?
questions.explanation: A tree with n vertices has n − 1 edges.
